regionNotice.title: Notice for Mainland China Users & Cross-Border Data Transfer Consent
regionNotice.body:
CoCode has detected that your location is in Mainland China. Rest assured, we do not ban accounts of users from Mainland China. However, in accordance with relevant laws of Mainland China, we need your consent: your data will be transferred to Cloudflare servers located outside Mainland China. If you do not agree to this cross-border transfer, please stop using and exit this application immediately.
As the servers are located outside Mainland China, your access to CoCode may be slow. A VPN is recommended.
